aiSummary.oneLiner: A fan-made engine recreation project for the classic Tomodachi Life series.
aiSummary.whatItDoes: This repository hosts an open-source reimplementation of the Tomodachi Life engine. It aims to accurately recreate the game's mechanics, UI, and interactions in a modern programming language. The project is designed to be highly moddable, allowing the community to add custom assets and features. It serves as a preservation effort for the classic life simulation genre. The engine handles rendering, state management, and the unique AI logic required for character interactions. It provides a foundation for fans to develop their own unique life simulation experiences.
keyFeatures: Engine recreation: Faithfully reconstructs the logic and mechanics of the original game.
Modding support: Allows easy integration of custom characters, items, and events.
Modern rendering: Utilizes contemporary graphics APIs for improved visual fidelity.
Character AI: Implements the complex interaction systems required for the simulation.
Cross-platform compatibility: Designed to compile and run across multiple operating systems.

useCases.title: Game development
useCases.description: Use the engine as a base for developing new, original life simulation games.

useCases.title: AI research
useCases.description: Analyze the character interaction logic to understand simulated social dynamics.

aiSummary.whoIsItFor: This project is for game developers and reverse engineers interested in life simulation mechanics. It is highly appealing to fans of the original series looking to create mods. Open-source contributors passionate about game preservation will find it an engaging project.
